selection.rule: Minimum heldout observed signed LNCC31 at fixed epoch 100; GT never used for ranking

geometry.visibility_rule: Fixed true-geometry visibility; fixed landmark IDs; no nearest-neighbour rematching
Fixed true-geometry visibility; fixed landmark IDs; no nearest-neighbour rematching

common_recipe_except_model_and_schedule.initialization: All B-spline coefficients exactly zero; sinespin nominal input P
common_recipe_except_model_and_schedule.loss: Single-resolution fixed observation-defined crop; no pooling/resampling

loss_config.name: signed_lncc
loss_config.smooth_dr_units: Floor for each weighted variance sum, not variance mean or variance product

regularization.input: Applied bounded nominal-relative motion9 = bounds * tanh(raw9); not raw9 or network weights
regularization.normalization: Mean squared (parameter / physical group scale) over views and three coordinates; scales may be set to training bounds
regularization.target: Zero nominal correction, not GT geometry or an estimated source position
regularization.limitation: A training prior that can bias geometry; not exact gauge removal or a guarantee of accurate P

image_roi.definition: Nominal-only per-view projection of known reference bead bounding boxes; 20px margin; common crop shape; frozen before fitting, no GT-dependent adaptation

limitations: Assumed small residual errors, not measured ARTIS icono tolerances. SOD/SDD 750/1200 mm are assumptions.
Primary simulation K is constant; shared K is a matched structural prior, not a demonstration of arbitrary K drift recovery.
Enlarged .4mm phantom uses virtual detector 1084x1038, not actual device footprint.
Same voxel object and Joseph family in independent generation and fitting; noise is Poisson only.
Odd views are validation for configuration ranking, not an independent external final test.
Single geometry/noise/optimization seed; no claim of universal optimizer improvement.
